_about: Prompts for the green-screen puppet part sheets (Google Gemini image model via OpenRouter). Generic paper puppets in club colours: no crests, no sponsors, no numbers, no real faces. Numbers are drawn in code.

sheets.name: bar
sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a paper puppet (cut-out paper doll) that will be animated with code. A generic footballer in a plain shirt with bold vertical stripes of deep blue and dark garnet red, plain blue shorts, garnet socks, black boots. NO badge, NO logo, NO number, NO lettering anywhere on the kit. Our own original cartoon design, not a portrait of any real person: oversized round head with short dark hair, simple dot eyes, bold expressive eyebrows, tiny body. Drawn as flat-coloured paper cut-out pieces with slightly rough hand-cut edges and a subtle paper texture, every piece separated and laid out with clear wide gaps on a pure flat chroma-green background (#00B140): head, torso with shirt, left upper arm, left forearm with hand, right upper arm, right forearm with hand, left leg with shorts, sock and boot, right leg with shorts, sock and boot; plus three extra head variants with expressions (determined shouting, joyful celebrating with open mouth, shocked/despairing). A small brass split-pin dot marks each joint position on each piece. No text, no labels, no cast shadows on the green background, nothing overlapping.
